label: Underwater Location
description: Beneath the surface. Tagged 'underwater' for genre- and subject-filtered templates.

items.name: coral-garden
items.text: A sunlit coral garden in crystal-clear shallows, fans and brain corals in saturated color, light ripples dancing across the sand.

items.name: kelp-cathedral
items.text: Inside a towering kelp forest, golden fronds rising like cathedral pillars toward the silvery surface far above.

items.name: shipwreck
items.text: A coral-crusted shipwreck listing on the seabed, shafts of light entering through torn hull plating.

items.name: blue-hole
items.text: The rim of a deep blue hole, bright turquoise flats dropping into an indigo abyss.

items.name: cenote-shaft
items.text: A flooded cenote lit by a single column of light from the jungle opening above, roots trailing down into clear water.

items.name: abyssal-vent-field
items.text: An abyssal hydrothermal vent field, black smokers shimmering with heat in the beam of a dive light.

items.name: under-ice
items.text: Beneath polar sea ice, the ceiling glowing turquoise, brine icicles reaching down into dark water.

items.name: seagrass-meadow
items.text: A gently waving seagrass meadow over white sand, dappled with moving light patterns.

items.name: reef-wall-drop
items.text: A vertical reef wall dropping into open blue, gorgonian fans and whip corals combing the current, exhaled bubbles ribboning up the rock face.

items.name: bioluminescent-bay
items.text: A shallow bay of bioluminescent plankton, every movement blooming cold blue light through the black water.
